AddMoneyRequest.description: Add money to a member's wallet. Any debt is paid off first.
AddMoneyRequest.title: AddMoneyRequest

Balance.description: A member's money in one guild. ``bank`` is negative while the member is in debt.
Balance.title: Balance

BearTrap.description: A guild's bear trap, as a guild manager sees it.
BearTrap.title: BearTrap

BearTrapChannel.description: The channel to set the bear trap in. ``None`` turns the trap off.
BearTrapChannel.title: BearTrapChannel

BearTrapKicks.description: The bear trap's kick count after a kick.
BearTrapKicks.title: BearTrapKicks

BearTrapMessage.description: The trap message the bot posted. ``None`` fields mean there is no message.
BearTrapMessage.title: BearTrapMessage

BearTrapState.description: A guild's bear trap with the bot's own bookkeeping.
BearTrapState.title: BearTrapState

ClearStars.description: Reactions removed from a message all at once. ``emoji: null`` means every emoji.
ClearStars.title: ClearStars

ClusterDay.description: One UTC day of a status block's (or the whole bot's) history. Fractions sum to 1.
ClusterDay.title: ClusterDay

ClusterHistory.description: A status block's daily history, oldest day first.
ClusterHistory.title: ClusterHistory

ClusterState.description: A status block on the status page.
ClusterState.title: ClusterState

ClusterStatus.description: How a status block of shards, or the whole bot, is doing.
ClusterStatus.title: ClusterStatus

ErrorBody.description: What the API returns when a request fails.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ErrorCode.description: Why a request failed. Clients branch on this, never on the message.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

GuildBearTrap.description: A guild's bear trap state, with the guild's ID.
GuildBearTrap.title: GuildBearTrap

GuildLocale.description: A guild's locale override, with the guild's ID.
GuildLocale.title: GuildLocale

GuildPrefix.description: A guild's prefix, with the guild's ID.
GuildPrefix.title: GuildPrefix

LeaderboardEntry.description: One member on a guild's leaderboard.
LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry

LocaleOverride.description: A guild's chosen bot language. ``None`` means it follows the members' and the guild's Discord locales.
LocaleOverride.title: LocaleOverride

ManagedGuild.description: A guild the signed-in user is a guild manager of.
ManagedGuild.title: ManagedGuild

MoveRequest.description: Move money between a member's own wallets. The source must hold the amount.
MoveRequest.title: MoveRequest

Prefix.description: A guild's command prefix and whether mentioning the bot also works as a prefix.
Prefix.title: Prefix

RemoveMoneyRequest.description: Take money from a member's wallet. Cash can't go negative. The bank can, which records debt.
RemoveMoneyRequest.title: RemoveMoneyRequest

SessionExchange.description: The Discord OAuth2 authorization code the dashboard received, to trade for a dashboard session.
SessionExchange.title: SessionExchange

ShardDay.description: One UTC day of a shard's history. Fractions cover the day, or its elapsed part for today, and sum to 1.
ShardDay.title: ShardDay

ShardHistory.description: A shard's daily history, oldest day first.
ShardHistory.title: ShardHistory

ShardState.description: A shard on the status page.
ShardState.title: ShardState

StarChange.description: A member added or removed a star. ``message_id`` may be the original or one of its posts.
StarChange.title: StarChange

StarResult.description:
The outcome of a star change. ``message`` is ``None`` when the API has never seen the message: the bot then
seeds it (an original) or ignores the change (a message in a board channel that isn't a post).
StarResult.title: StarResult

StarSeed.description: Everyone who starred a message with an emoji, read from Discord the first time the API sees the message.
StarSeed.title: StarSeed

StarboardBlock.description: A message blocked from a board.
StarboardBlock.title: StarboardBlock

StarboardEntry.description: A message on one board: its post there, if any, and whether a moderator blocked it.
StarboardEntry.title: StarboardEntry

StarboardPost.description: The post the bot made for a message on a board. ``None`` fields record that it removed the post.
StarboardPost.title: StarboardPost

StarboardUpdate.description: Changes to a board. Fields left out keep their value; ``max_age_days: null`` removes the limit.
StarboardUpdate.title: StarboardUpdate

StarredMessage.description: A message's stars with one emoji, and its entries on the boards that use the emoji.
StarredMessage.title: StarredMessage

StatusHistory.description: The bot's daily history, oldest day first. Blocks are today's layout.
StatusHistory.title: StatusHistory

TransferRequest.description: Move cash from one member to another. If it fails, neither balance changes.
TransferRequest.title: TransferRequest
